player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely concluded the task by issuing "DONE" while in the Gallery, failing to realize that the "east" direction led to the Playroom, which I had visited before but might have unexplored exits from, or that the loop I was in (Gallery-Playroom-Craft room-Pantry-Recreation room) did not cover all possible branches. Specifically, when I returned to the Playroom (after coming from the Craft room via south), I chose "west" to go back to the Gallery, ignoring the "north" and "east" options which I had not fully explored in that specific context or might lead to new rooms. My mistake was assuming that revisiting a room meant all its paths were exhausted without verifying if I had taken every available direction from that room at least once. Next time, I will maintain a mental map of "visited directions" for each room. If I return to a room like the Playroom, I will check if I have tried all available directions (north, west, east). If I have not tried "north" or "east" from the Playroom yet, I will prioritize those over returning to the Gallery. I will only issue "DONE" when I am in a room where all available directions lead to rooms I have already visited *and* I have confirmed that every direction from every visited room has been attempted.
